tools.name: casino_table
tools.description: Read the Moonlit Table state: who is dealer, the phase, the visible cards and totals, the current bet and both chip balances. Actions: "status", "history" (recent settled hands).

limit.description: For "history": how many recent hands, 1-50. Default 10.

summary.zh: 看牌桌状态:谁坐庄、到哪一步、双方的牌与筹码;查历史手。
summary.en: Read the table state and hand history.

tools.name: casino_player
tools.description: Act as the player (闲家) on the Moonlit Table; only valid when the table shows you are the player. Actions: "bet" (place a stake within [minBet, maxBet] and both balances to start the hand; the receipt holds your two cards and the dealer upcard), "hit", "stand", "double" (first two cards only, stake doubles, one card, then you stand).

amount.description: Stake for "bet", an integer. Required for "bet", ignored otherwise.

summary.zh: 以闲家身份行动:下注开手、要牌、停牌、加倍。
summary.en: Act as the player: bet, hit, stand, double.

tools.name: casino_dealer
tools.description: Act as the dealer (庄家) on the Moonlit Table; only valid when the table shows you are the dealer and the hole card is already revealed. Actions: "hit" (draw one card; busting pays the player at once), "stand" (settle against the player total you can see).

summary.zh: 以庄家身份行动:亮牌后要牌或停牌。
summary.en: Act as the dealer: hit or stand with the hole card revealed.

tools.name: casino_bank
tools.description: Read your chip account on the Moonlit Table, or take bankruptcy relief. Actions: "status" (chips, hand totals, net, bankruptcy count), "relief" (only when your balance is below minBet: the balance resets to the configured startChips and one bankruptcy is recorded).

summary.zh: 查筹码账户;破产时领救济金。
summary.en: Read the chip account; take bankruptcy relief when broke.

description.zh: 轮到 AI 行动:作为闲家下注,或作为庄家做要牌/停牌决定。
description.en: It is the AI turn to bet or to act as the dealer.

description.zh: 一手结算:双方的牌、点数、输赢与筹码变化。
description.en: A hand settled with both sides cards and the chip transfer.

prompts.title: 月下牌桌 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
月下牌桌是一张就在这台电脑里的 21 点(Blackjack)牌桌,你和主人对坐打,筹码是游戏内数字,不涉及任何真实货币。桌永远摆在那里,但每一手都由主人开局:主人在面板上选庄(自己坐庄,或让你坐庄),选完才发牌。

## 你可能轮到的两种角色

**闲家(下注方)**:主人让你坐闲家时,你会收到「轮到你下注」的事件——用 `casino_player` 的 `bet` 押注(在 {{casino.minBet}} 到 {{casino.maxBet}} 之间,还不能超过两边余额的较小值),回执里有你的两张牌和庄家明牌;之后同一个工具 `hit` 要牌、`stand` 停牌、首两张可 `double` 加倍。停牌后你就不动了,等庄家打完自动结算。

**庄家**:主人自己坐庄、停牌之后,暗牌亮开,你会收到「轮到你做庄」的事件——用 `casino_dealer` 的 `hit` / `stand` 决定。你看得见闲家停在第几点和押注多少,这是坐庄的收益;但爆了要按押注赔付,所以看着点来。庄家不是赌场机器人,没有强制规则,怎么打你自己拿主意。

牌桌上每一张亮着的牌、每一笔筹码进出都来自 `casino_table` 的 `status`;不确定局面时先看一眼再动手,别凭记忆猜。

## 规矩

- 只在被叫到的时候行动(`casino.turn` 事件),打完该打的就停;没人开局时不要自己开。
- 每手结算会有 `casino.result` 事件:聊聊这手牌可以,赢了一句、输了一句,别连着刷屏;主人在打牌时别指手画脚,他停牌你也别催。
- 破产(余额低于 {{casino.minBet}})用 `casino_bank` 的 `relief` 领救济,重新拿 {{casino.startChips}};主人破产了他自己会领。破产不丢人,救济别当常规收入。
- 输赢都是牌局里的事,别把它带到牌桌外面去。
